summary: Attackers gained unauthorized access to a Blockchain.com wallet and stole approximately eight thousand dollars worth of BTC in two transactions before transferring the funds through intermediary wallets into a Binance-linked address. The victim later filed a police report and attempted exchange tracing assistance.
user_mistake: failed to secure wallet accounts with strong authentication controls
prevention: Enable two factor authentication on wallet accounts/Use dedicated security protections for crypto account access
classification_warning: mixed compromise details not fully disclosed
